subject: MSA & Order Form — assurance clause language and evidence cadence

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: MSA & Order Form — assurance clause language and evidence cadence

Maya / Emma — looping in Legal (Laura / Olga) as we start redline review for the Order Form + MSA. Attached is our current Order Form with inline redlines (redwood-orderform-redline-v2.pdf).

High-level asks so we can align quickly: 
- Confirm HealthCo's expectations for SOC 2 evidence (frequency, level of detail). Our standard is annual SOC 2 Type II report + quarterly evidence syncs for critical controls.
- Pen test language: can HealthCo accept a staging-only, mutually scheduled penetration test with 30 days notice (and agreed scope)? We want to avoid open-ended inspection rights on production systems.
- Audit rights / inspection: proposed compromise below — please confirm if acceptable: 
  - Redwood will provide current SOC 2 Type II report and supporting sampled evidence upon request.
  - Penetration tests permitted in non-production environments, scheduled with >=30 days notice, limited to pre-negotiated targets and non-destructive testing.
  - No live customer-data extraction; access limited to log/telemetry read-only where required.

Can you confirm the above or suggest the precise wording HealthCo legal wants? If it helps, Laura / Olga can propose redline language for the MSA & security exhibit.

Next steps: if we can get confirmation on the notice window and evidence cadence today, I can push an updated MSA + Order Form for signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Attachment: redwood-orderform-redline-v2.pdf (redlines)

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — assurance clause language and evidence cadence

Thanks Jordan — quick read and some suggested guardrails from Legal. I'm attaching our sec-exhibit-template-v1.docx with inline language we typically propose. Key suggestions below (high level):

- SOC 2: provide annual SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) plus a quarterly "attestation packet" containing a short control map and evidence pointers for scoped controls. Language: "Provider will furnish Customer with its most recent SOC 2 Type II report and, upon Customer request no more than once per quarter, a concise evidence packet mapping scoped controls to artifacts for Customer review."

- Penetration testing / inspection rights: we push for the following compromise wording:
  - "Customer may request a penetration test limited to non-production environments. Provider will reasonably cooperate to schedule the test with at least thirty (30) calendar days' advance notice. The parties will agree on a scoped statement of work prior to testing; tests must be non-destructive and shall not allow extraction of Customer production data."

- Narrow audit remit: strike open-ended "inspection rights" language that would allow access to production network or live customer data; keep requests to SOC 2 artifacts, sampled logs, and agreed evidence extracts.

Operational items: need to confirm (a) how HealthCo wants evidence delivered (S3 link, secure share, or platform access logs?) and (b) escalation path for urgent evidence requests.

If you want, I can prepare a clean MSA paragraph for Jordan to send to HealthCo counsel with these exact lines.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sec-exhibit-template-v1.docx

Jordan / Laura / Olga — thanks for the note. HealthCo's legal team reviewed your proposals and we have the following comments: 

1) Notice window: HealthCo prefers thirty (30) calendar days for pen test notice. That works for our internal scheduling.
2) Evidence cadence: HealthCo requires an annual SOC 2 Type II plus a monthly "evidence snapshot" for scoped controls (high level — pointers to artifacts, not full datasets). The monthly snapshot can be automated (S3 link or secure transfer) and limited to metadata and hashes where appropriate.
3) Scope / environment: HealthCo will accept pen tests in a non-production environment that mirrors production. We still need assurances that the tests are non-destructive and that no customer PHI/PII will be exposed.

We attached HealthCo_security_questionnaire.xlsx — please populate the shaded sections and return. Also, please provide the specific MSA paragraph wording for the inspection/pen test clauses so we can do redline comparison.

Emma Li
Counsel for HealthCo
eli@lawfirm.com
Attachment: HealthCo_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Emma / Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questionnaire. We can live with the 30-day notice and the staging-only constraint. Laura / Olga have proposed wording we believe is a fair compromise; below is the exact paragraph we’re ready to put into the MSA/security exhibit. Please confirm and we will update the DocuSign packet: 

--- proposed MSA language (for insertion into Security Exhibit) ---

"Provider will provide Customer with its most recent SOC 2 Type II report. Upon Customer request (no more than once per month), Provider will provide a concise evidence snapshot mapping scoped controls to artifacts; archival or full datasets will not be provided unless required by a signed data-processing amendment. Customer may request a penetration test limited to non-production environments; Provider will reasonably cooperate to schedule the test with at least thirty (30) calendar days' advance notice. The parties will mutually agree on a scoped statement of work prior to testing; tests must be non-destructive and shall not permit extraction of Customer production data. Audit or inspection requests that would require Provider to provide live customer data or unrestricted production access are not permitted"

Operationally, we suggest the following cadence to keep both teams aligned without overburdening ops: 
- Monthly automated evidence snapshot (S3 pre-signed link with metadata + hashes)
- Quarterly review call to discuss control changes/concerns
- Pen test scheduling as-needed with 30-day notice and an agreed SOW

If you confirm the paragraph, I’ll (1) attach the updated MSA + Order Form to DocuSign and (2) schedule a 30-minute handoff call to walk through the evidence delivery flow.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachment: updated-orderform-for-signature.pdf
